headline: Public hearings on the FY2027 minimum residential factor and four utility projects; loan orders for Bailey, McAvinnue, and Shaughnessy schools.
summary: Votes include accepting a $35,640 EMPG grant for the fire department, accepting a $75k Mass DEP SMRP grant, and authorizing contracts with Tec, Inc. The agenda also includes council motions, city manager responses, a cemetery fee ordinance, and an executive session on two Open Meeting Law complaints.
items: Remote and Zoom participation information
Cancel council meetings on December 1 and December 29, 2026
Public hearing on the FY2027 minimum residential factor (MRF)
Public hearing: Boston Gas gas main replacement at 61 Durant Street
Public hearing: Boston Gas gas main installation on Old Ferry Road to Pawtucket Boulevard
Public hearing: Boston Gas gas main replacement on 18th Street alongside 598 Beacon Street
Public hearing: National Grid handhole installation in sidewalk in front of 114 Merrimack Street
Council motion on plans for Callery Park (C. Descoteaux)
Council motion on a plan for cannabis consumption lounges and related zoning (C. Robinson)
Council motion on lighting in the Greenhalge School gymnasium (C. Robinson)
Council motion on a discussion between LHA and the city council (C. Robinson)
Council motion on warning markers for new sidewalk extensions (C. Mercier)
Council motion on lights at the basketball courts at N. Common Park (C. Liang)
Council motion on an illegal dumping plan at the Cupples Square parking lot (C. Chau)
Five city manager motion responses on topics including school heating and fire hydrants
Informational reports: FY27 MRF public hearing guide and an MSBA grant award for three schools
Confirm executive session votes for Draper Laboratory
Accept and spend $35,640 EMPG grant for the fire department
Accept and spend $75k Mass DEP SMRP grant
Authorize city manager to sign contracts with Tec, Inc.
Loan orders for MSBA ARP funding for Bailey, McAvinnue, and Shaughnessy schools
Ordinance to amend the cemetery fee schedule
Three property damage claims
Request for a handicap parking sign at 20 White St (Lorraine Aguiar)
Boston Gas request to install about 100 feet of replacement gas main between 304-330 W Sixth St
Boston Gas request to install about 1,515 feet of plastic gas main on Waugh St, Bertha St, and Wilder St
National Grid request to install 4-inch conduit from MH141 to 681 Merrimack St for a new building
Executive session on two open meeting law complaints filed October 29, 2026
